display_long_description:
**MINE ORES. SHOOT ALIENS.**                                                                                                                                                                           
[media]

ENTER DANGEROUS CAVES, MINE VALUABLE MINERALS, AND FIGHT OFF ALIEN CREATURES TO SURVIVE.

**EXPLORE MASSIVE CAVES.**
[media]

NAVIGATE VAST UNDERGROUND ENVIRONMENTS FILLED WITH RESOURCES, HIDDEN PATHS, AND CONSTANT DANGER.

**CUSTOMIZE YOUR AVATAR**
[media]
CUSTOMIZE YOUR MINER WITH UNIQUE DNA BUILDS. PLACE THE ACCESSORIES WHEREVER YOU WANT!

**FIGHT BOSSES.** 
[media]
CLAIM TREASURE. TAKE DOWN POWERFUL BOSSES DEEP UNDERGROUND AND CLAIM RARE REWARDS.

**TECH TREE.**
[media]
UPGRADE YOUR GEAR AND ABILITIES TO BECOME STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN.

**PLAY TOGETHER.**
[media]
TEAM UP WITH UP TO 11 PLAYERS AND SURVIVE THE MINES.

**WELCOME TO THE MINES.**
[media]
ENTER A PORTAL, GO DEEPER, AND SURVIVE THE RUN.

**UPDATES EVERY WEDNESDAY.**

JOIN THE DISCORD 👉 https://discord.com/invite/pickaboom

**WELCOME, MINER. CONGRATULATIONS ON JOINING PICKABOOM!** IF YOU’RE A HARD WORKER, A GOOD SHOT AND A RELIABLE TEAM PLAYER, YOU SHOULD HAVE RESPECTABLE ODDS OF SURVIVAL.
